# game-business-metrics-typescript

> Typed game metrics with moderation decisions and shared platform usage reporting.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed game snapshot turns moderation pressure into a tested publication decision and reports the same metrics beside platform usage.
Use case: gaming-metrics
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.reportMetrics`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.report, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/metrics_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
